messages:
maria: Ok team — proposal to land FlashAttention v2 + v3 support in runtime. Goal: automatic kernel selection + opt-in feature flag for v3. Outline: 1) runtime kernel chooser picks v3 for L <= 2048 when GPU arch >= sm80, v2 as fallback; 2) add `flashattn.experimental=v3` flag at route/model level; 3) ensure KV cache hotpath unchanged (no extra copies); 4) phased rollout with perf alarms and canary. Thoughts?

raj: +1 on kernel chooser but need to nail heuristic for sequence length distribution. For long tail workloads switching to v3 can regress due to memory layout. Suggest percentile-based rule: if P75_seq <= 1024 prefer v3, else v2.

maria: Good call. Let's encode heuristic as: `if (gpu.sm >= 80 && p75_seq <= 1024 && avg_batch_tokens_per_gpu < threshold) choose v3 else v2`. We'll tune threshold from perf runs.

ben: KV cache question: does v3 change KV layout? If we must convert tensors each request it'll kill latency.

kevin: FlashAttention v3 requires contiguous KV planes with specific stride for fused kernels. I profiled conversion cost: average extra copy ~ 0.6ms for seq=512 on A100, ~1.8ms for seq=2048. But if we reuse cached layout across requests, amortized cost near zero.

sophie: So we need a migration path: when switching kernel for a model instance, keep old KV format for active sessions and warm caches with background conversion for new sessions. Propose a compat shim: runtime exposes `kv_format` metadata and a `convert_kv_async` job.

maria: Agree. Rollout plan: Phase 0 - internal benchmark + smoke tests (CI). Phase 1 - canary 5% traffic with `flashattn.experimental=v3` on non-sensitive routes. Phase 2 - increase to 25% with perf alarms enabled. Phase 3 - full rollout. Each phase gated by SLO: p50 token latency not worse than baseline +1.5ms and error rate < 0.1%.

ci-bot: Benchmark artifacts uploaded: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/bench/1765123456. Summary: v3 median throughput +8% for seq<=512, -3% for seq>=2048. Conversion overhead measured: 0.6ms@512, 1.8ms@2048.

raj: We need automated perf regression detection for canaries. Suggest adding these checks to rollout pipeline: compare `canary` vs `control` for p50/p95 and token throughput, abort if p95 regresses >5% or p50 > +1.5ms. Add alert to #eng-runtime-incidents.

kevin: Also watch GPU memory pressure. v3 fused kernels can increase peak memory by ~4-8% depending on caching behavior. Add a mem metric and fallback trigger to `force_v2` if mem > 90% for > 30s.

ben: For batching heuristics: keep continuous batching enabled but prefer smaller max batch size when v3 chosen (experiments show lower batching gains for fused kernels at long seq). Proposed defaults: v2 max_batch=64, v3 max_batch=48 for seq>1024.

maria: Action items: 1) kevin implement kernel chooser + kv_format metadata (PR by EOD Fri). 2) ben add batch-size policy per kernel + unit tests. 3) raj add canary perf checks + alert hooks. 4) sophie add kv conversion shim + migration plan. 5) I will draft rollout doc and flags schema.

sophie: Quick note — please include deterministic seed and identical workloads when comparing canaries, otherwise noise kills signal.

maria: Noted. I'll add a perf harness job that replays production buckets with identical seeds.

raj: One more: include a debug endpoint `/_internal/kernel/debug` that returns chosen kernel, kv_format, and last_conversion_ts so we can validate during canary.

maria: Perfect. If nobody objects I'll open the feature branch and tag reviewers. :rocket:

ben: No objections. :thumbsup:

kevin: LGTM. I'll start the perf runs tomorrow morning. :eyes:
